summary: Iteration-5 regression pass on the six review-request areas: (1) first-launch onboarding, (2) new login backdrop + wordmark, (3) biometric quick-unlock web-fallback, (4) silent emergency alert banner, (5) Water Quality trend chart, (6) existing screen regressions. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_regression_iter5.py — GET /api/ 200 with {status:ok,service:envirolytics-mobile-backend}, GET /api/health 200 with poll_interval_s=300 (int), POST /api/admin/run-auto-deactivate 200 {status:scheduled} on both invocations, log confirms 'auto-deactivate cycle handled 0 user(s)' and the admin-skip loop iterates without exceptions, POST /api/email-subscriptions round-trips weekly:true→GET reads it back, then monthly:true→GET reads that back independently, POST /api/register-push 422 on missing device_token AND accepts the full body including the new `role` field (non-422; 500 is expected because EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is placeholder in the preview env). Frontend (390x844, https://field-data-viewer.preview.emergentagent.com): after localStorage.clear() the cold-start route resolves to /onboarding — Slide 1 renders 'Live Field Monitoring' with testID onboarding-slide-live, tapping onboarding-next advances to Slide 2 (onboarding-slide-compliance) and CTA copy flips from 'Next' to 'Get started' verbatim, tapping again markOnboardingSeen persists envirolytics.onboarding_seen="1" and router.replace('/login') fires (URL confirmed /login); a subsequent page reload skips onboarding and goes straight to /login as spec'd. Login screen: login-brand + login-form present, lion logo + wordmark image render inside markWrap/wordmarkWrap with the pulsing green heartbeat halo (heartHaloStyle/heartbeatStyle applied), LoginHero backdrop composes navy gradient + smokestack (AirLayer) top-left + AQI ring (AqiBadge) top-right + animated water tank (WaterTank) bottom-left + soil probe (SoilStrip) bottom + double AnalyticsWave heart-monitor across mid-screen — no crashes, no red screen. All 5 feature chips present verbatim: 'Real-time data' · '24 × 7' · 'CGWA ready' · 'SGWA ready' · 'CPCB / SPCB ready'. login-biometric-button is NOT rendered on web (bioSupport.supported returns false via getBiometricSupport web branch — expo-local-authentication is never invoked on Platform.OS==='web', safe fallback confirmed). Signing in as admin@envirolytics.com / Admin@Envirolytics2026 succeeds → /dashboard renders dashboard-screen (site header 'Lucknow HQ · MQTT', 0/0/0/0 stat tiles + LIVE WEATHER card). Emergency banner: [data-testid=emergency-banner] is null on the test tenant (empty stp/do/chlorine arrays) — AlertBanner.collectAlerts returns [] and the component returns null; no red banner, no UI hang, no crash, /api/water-quality/latest polling runs in background without blocking. Devices tab loads and pH / TDS / Conductivity filter chips are all present. Water Quality tab loads (testID water-quality-screen — NOT quality-screen), all 12 params render with 'NO DATA' amber pills as expected for the empty tenant. Tapping wq-item-stp-COD navigates to /wq/stp/COD, wq-trend-screen renders with eyebrow 'STP · TREND' verbatim, parameter name 'COD' in header, wq-trend-verdict pill reads 'No data', chart empty-state 'Waiting for the first reading…' present, safe range copy under the value present, wq-trend-back arrow navigates back to /quality restoring water-quality-screen. Admin → /admin/users shows the golden 'GOD' badge on Envirolytics Admin and the verbatim 'No expiry · GOD mode' meta line. Profile tab renders profile-screen. Only cosmetic RN-Web console warnings observed (pre-existing): 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents', '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. All 6 review-request areas pass.
action_items: No blocking action items. Optional polish (not iteration-5 scope): the three pre-existing RN-Web console warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, expo-notifications web push listener) are cosmetic — track for a future cleanup pass. Migrate `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` to `style.pointerEvents` when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: src/utils/biometric.ts::getBiometricSupport short-circuits with a synthetic all-false BiometricSupport when Platform.OS==='web' (lines 26-35), so expo-local-authentication is NEVER dynamically imported on the web bundle — no crash, no runtime error. authenticate() also early-returns false on web (line 53). Login screen gates the biometric TouchableOpacity behind bioSupport?.supported && bioSaved so the button correctly does not render on the web preview. Safe.

app/onboarding.tsx uses FlatList horizontal+pagingEnabled+getItemLayout for the 2-slide swipe experience; onViewableItemsChanged updates the dot indicator, and the CTA label ternary ('Next' vs 'Get started') flips based on index — verified live. finish() calls markOnboardingSeen() BEFORE router.replace so a returning user reload correctly bypasses onboarding.

app/index.tsx boot router waits for auth.ready, then asyncs hasSeenOnboarding() and router.replace('/login' | '/onboarding') — correct precedence: authenticated → dashboard, unseen → onboarding, seen → login.

src/components/AlertBanner.tsx::collectAlerts iterates stp/do/chlorine meta+readings and returns [] when readings arrays are empty (which they are for the test tenant), so `if (alerts.length === 0) return null` (line 96) means the sticky bar is completely absent from the DOM — good, no accessibility bleed. The 90s poll interval is reasonable and load() swallows network errors silently so UI never freezes.

app/wq/[group]/[param].tsx correctly handles empty upstream by defaulting verdict to 'No data' when latestValue===null and rendering the 'Waiting for the first reading…' empty-state (both strings verified live). wq-trend-back uses router.back() so the parent quality tab is restored, and the SafeAreaView respects insets.

src/components/LoginHero.tsx renders four native SVG scenes (AirLayer/AqiBadge/WaterTank/SoilStrip) plus a double AnalyticsWave, all reanimated via useAnimatedProps/useSharedValue — pointerEvents='none' on every layer ensures the login form remains fully interactive.

backend/server.py unchanged for iteration-5 — no new endpoints, no risk of regression. The iteration-4 admin-skip in _auto_deactivate_expired_users still fires correctly (log 'auto-deactivate cycle handled 0 user(s)' after each POST /api/admin/run-auto-deactivate).
